subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: Youre part of a group seeing what others miss. 800+ users already changed how they date.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, a user named Jenna scanned a text from her boyfriend at 2AM. It said, 'Youre too sensitive, as always.' The app flagged it as gaslighting—pattern score 87%. She told me, 'I saw it in black and white. I finally stopped doubting myself.'

Youre now part of a growing group of people who refuse to ignore what their gut already knows. 800+ of us have scanned over 10,000 conversations. We spot the love bombing, the manipulation, the subtle digs—before they become cycles. This isnt just an app. Its a tribe of people choosing clarity over confusion.

Your relationship health dashboard is where this tribe lives. Open it and see your own pattern detection score—how many red flags youve identified across your convos. Every scan adds to your story, and to ours. Youre not alone in this.
Open Red Flag Scanner AI and check your dashboard now. See where you stand. P.S. Jenna ended things that week. She says the app gave her proof her gut was right all along.
